# Source previews

Public publisher preview images, video thumbnails, repository artwork, and one publisher logo, retrieved October 27, 2026 for this local roundtable. Original source and image URLs are recorded in `provenance.json`. The presentation links each image to the matching source. These images identify source material; they are not evidence for claims beyond what the linked source reports.

The original, code-drawn `moonshot.svg` is a conceptual earn/spend diagram for the closing discussion, not a product screenshot or demonstrated integration.

`perception.svg` is an original qualitative illustration for Karpathy’s October 11 post. It has no numerical scale and is not a reproduction of his population estimates.
